name: – Marta Temido, Adam Jarubas – Article 1 – § 1 – point 3; Directive 2001/18/EC – Article 24d – § 1 – Am 128
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Directive of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directives 2001/18/EC and 2010/53/EU as regards the placing on the market of genetically modified micro-organisms and the processing of organs
part_text: 1. The deliberate release into the environment of a GMM shall not be authorised unless scientifically validated methods are available to enable its detection and identification and, where technically feasible, its quantification, in order to ensure effective monitoring, traceability and enforcement throughout and following its release into the environment. The authorisation holder shall be responsible for developing and maintaining such methods.
